# Data Fill references

R2.2 Reference pp. 4-5/4-6 and real initialized R2.2 under DOS33/QEMU
486/8MiB. `capture.sh RUNTIME NEW_OUT SCENARIO` uses goldens/dataloss/drive.c;
all consumed results retain exact input steps, raw VGA, transcriptions, saved
WK1 bytes and monitor logs. SHA256SUMS pins the evidence, never product output.
The initial formatted probe missed a Return and is excluded; formatted/
contains the corrected decimal-places/range sequence. The initial memory
wait used the wrong case; memory/ is the completed `Memory full` replay.

Fill first clears the complete inclusive range column-first, preserving
formats, then writes the numeric series. Early stop leaves the tail cleared.
A protected B2 exposes the erasure prefix, not numeric prefix: A1:A3/B1
become BLANK while B2/B3 retain their labels. Memory full later exposes the
numeric prefix. The memory VGA is stale; FULLREF.WK1 is authoritative and
contains 32768 integers. The native model's documented 2048-cell capacity is
smaller, so its failure check compares its complete 2048-cell prefix against
the corresponding independent real records. No series is generated by tests.

Fractional/descending/zero steps, start beyond stop (clears all), decimal
.1/.1/.3 (only .1 and .2), formats, names and expressions are retained.
Defaults store evaluated numbers: BASE/2+3/BASE+20 become 10/5/30 even after
D1 changes. Accepted parameters remain defaults after Cancel; Cancel itself
does not change/dirty the worksheet. Retrieve and Worksheet Erase reset all
three defaults to 0/1/8191. Invalid scalar reports `Invalid number input`;
Esc returns READY without writing. reuse/ and invalid/ pin those cases.
